This scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. Add that Mengzi thinks copying the worshippers is fun, to show why he keeps doing it. e.g. 他觉得祭拜很好玩。
2. Add Mengmu’s worried thought or speech about this place not being good for Mengzi. e.g. 孟母想：“这里不适合孟子。”
3. Add a detail about the many merchants selling things, so the new neighbourhood feels busy and lively. e.g. 每天有很多商人卖东西。
